empty.title: No skills yet
empty.body: Import a skill from a file, a URL, or the community catalog.
empty.bodyCreate: Create a skill from scratch, or import one from a file.

selectPrompt.title: Select a skill
selectPrompt.body: Pick a skill on the left to preview its body.

drawer.title: Add a skill
drawer.subtitle: Import from a file, a URL, or search vetted community skills
drawer.subtitleFile: Import a skill from a Markdown file or a .zip archive

fileStep.intro: Choose a .md, .markdown or .zip file. Nothing is saved until you review it and confirm.
fileStep.limits: Up to 1 MiB for Markdown and 5 MiB for a .zip archive.

previewStep.notice: The body below becomes the agent's instructions. An imported skill arrives disabled until you vet it and turn it on.
previewStep.name: Name
previewStep.bodyHint: Read it before you accept — this is exactly what the agent will be told.
previewStep.truncated: The body was truncated — part of the source is not included below.

ignored.title: Ignored archive entries ({count})
ignored.hint: These entries were left out of the skill.

reason.executable: Executable — not read and not run
reason.not-markdown: Not a Markdown file — not read

file.nameHint: Optional — derived from the first heading if blank.
file.bodyHint: Pasted content is wrapped as untrusted data — never executed as instructions.

url.label: Skill URL
url.hint: Fetched server-side, stored as untrusted, and left disabled until vetted.
url.success: Imported "{name}". Disabled until you vet + enable it.

preview.untrustedNotice: This skill came from an untrusted source. Its body is stored as data (delimiter-wrapped) and must be vetted before it is enabled for an agent.
preview.bodyHint: Saving a changed body creates a new immutable version.
preview.heading: Preview
preview.caption: Rendered as the reviewing agent receives it.
preview.emptyBody: This skill has no body yet.

fields.name: Name
fields.descriptionPlaceholder: When this skill applies, phrased as an instruction
fields.descriptionHint: The description is the skill's interface: it tells the agent when the skill applies. Phrase it as an instruction, for example "Apply when a change adds or edits tests".

note.title: Describe this change
note.body: The note is stored with the new version and shown in the Versions tab.
note.label: Change note

card.footer: {count, plural, one {# agent} other {# agents}} · {pull}% pull · {accept}% accept

deleteDialog.title: Delete skill?
deleteDialog.body: "{name}" will be deleted and unlinked from every agent that uses it. This cannot be undone.

editor.placeholder: The {tab} tab is not built yet.

stats.loadError: Could not load this skill's stats.

usedBy.label: Used by
usedBy.caption: Agents that currently link this skill.

pull.label: Pull frequency
pull.caption: Runs that included it, of runs by its agents. Per run, last 30 days.

accept.label: Accept rate
accept.caption: Accepted of decided findings in those runs. Per run, last 30 days.

findings.label: Findings (30d)
findings.caption: Raised in runs that included it, not caused by it.

empty.title: No agents yet
empty.body: No agent links this skill. Link it from an agent's Skills tab.

category.title: Findings by category
category.chartLabel: {count, plural, one {# finding} other {# findings}} by category

empty.title: No findings yet
empty.body: Findings show up here once an agent that uses this skill has reviewed a pull request.

versions.title: Version history
versions.intro: Every save snapshots the body, so a past review can be read against the exact text it ran on. Restoring an old version creates a new one; history is never rewritten.
versions.diffLabel: Diff v{version} against the current body
versions.loadError: Could not load the version history.

empty.title: No versions yet
empty.body: A version appears here the first time the skill is saved.

restoreDialog.title: Restore v{version}?
restoreDialog.body: The current body is saved as a version, then v{version}'s body becomes current as v{next}. Nothing in the history is deleted.

diff.title: v{version} → current (v{current})
diff.subtitle: Lines removed since v{version} are marked −, lines added since are marked +.
diff.identical: This version is identical to the current body.
diff.added: {count, plural, one {+# line added} other {+# lines added}}
diff.removed: {count, plural, one {−# line removed} other {−# lines removed}}

create.title: Create skill
create.subtitle: A skill is a rule the reviewing agent follows, stored as versioned Markdown.
